reviews.name: Susan
reviews.text: We absolutely loved the kindness of our driver, cleanliness of our car, and how beautiful our car was. We chose Carmen for our wedding day and wouldn’t have had it any other way.

reviews.name: J Williams
reviews.text: It was a pleasure dealing with Chance Classic cars- the entire line of cars are so beautiful and it was hard to choose. My daughter and new son-in-law loved how the pictures turned out with Brenda the blue beauty! Perfect end to a perfect day!

reviews.name: Elizabeth Lofton
reviews.text: The absolute best experience ever! This was my nieces wedding and we loved everything about Chance Classic Cars!!

reviews.name: John Michael Cristler
reviews.text: Great service! They took care of everything we needed

reviews.name: Ayden McDermott
reviews.text: Using Chance Classic for our wedding made the day incredibly special and truly unforgettable. From the moment we got into the car, it created a once-in-a-lifetime feeling and gave us such a meaningful, timeless experience we will always cherish. Booking was so easy, and with a wide variety of classic cars to choose from, we found the perfect fit for our wedding style. Tim was amazing and made everything perfect for us! The drive to our hotel felt smooth and safe, and adding a pink bow made it even more personal and memorable! I would choose them all over again! Such a sweet moment for us!❤️

reviews.name: Megan Acosta
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible! We rented Brenda, the 1961 Buick convertible, for our wedding getaway car and could not be happier with our experience! The Chance Classic team is great to work with, and they even toughed out the (very unexpected) rain to make the end our wedding night perfect! Truly could not recommend them more!!

reviews.name: Rodrick Carter
reviews.text: I just wanted to take the time to say thank you for an awesome experience. Phyllis and your driver gave us a dream send off that was nothing short of epic. Again, thank you for allowing us to make memorable memories.

reviews.name: Colton herren
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a nice classic car for any occasion, Mr Tim with Chance Classics is the person to call. His Chevelle was the perfect car for my fiancé bridal pictures. Very friendly and professional. Will rent from again

reviews.name: Katie Lettau
reviews.text: Chance Classics was extremely easy to work with and had the best selections of cars to choose from!  Highly recommend!
